# Maxwell Electrodeal

> Website engineering company for businesses — headquartered in Vadodara, Gujarat, India. Manufacturer catalogs, GIDC estate sites, owned enquiry channels, dealer portals, plus supporting web apps, ERP, CRM, and AI.

Maxwell Electrodeal Private Limited is distinct from electronics component manufacturers with a similar name.
